Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Contributor Josh Honeycutt breaks down the profound impact of hunting mentorship, exploring why it is equally vital to guide the next generation and to have a mentor of your own. The episode highlights the true reward of these bonds by showcasing a memorable hunt where Josh's guidance and mentorship make a massive, life-changing impact on a young hunter.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Daniel Schmidt and Zach Haas dive into the topic of Epizootic Hemorrhagic Disease (EHD), exploring what it is, how it spreads, and the impact it has on whitetail deer populations. Daniel then takes viewers back ten years to a memorable hunt in Kansas where he harvested a buck that had survived EHD. The remarkable deer carried lasting signs of its battle with the disease, including a severely deformed club foot believed to be the result of surviving the infection. This episode offers a fascinating look at deer resilience and provides hunters with a deeper understanding of one of the most significant diseases affecting whitetails today.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Mark Kayser reveals the secrets to building and positioning mock scrapes to outsmart mature bucks and orchestrate the ultimate whitetail setup.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Dan Schmidt sits down with Adam Hays to discuss the key strategies he uses to tag trophy-class whitetails year after year, from the U.S. to Canada.

programme.title: The Cast

The brothers spend a day in the boat with Bryant Stark of Rising Rivers, fishing the White and the Norfork. Though the White is much larger waters than back home, Trevor utilizes his experience to catch them even while wading.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton makes a trip to South Carolina to fish Lake Murray. He meets up with the Rather Outdoors crew to spend time on the water and at the Rather HQ checking out all the gear from Lews and Strike King.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh

Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh

Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh

programme.desc: The boys are at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma getting the Oklahoma turkey season kicked off.

programme.title: HuntStand Origins
programme.desc: The brush country of South Texas has been a living laboratory — and a proving ground — where true visionaries and pure dedication transformed what we know about managing the whitetail. Join us on a road trip that brings us across legendary ranches, deep into groundbreaking research, and through stories of the men who helped build the modern whitetail movement.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Nearly 7 years after her husband’s tragic and unexpected passing, Nana returns to her farm and embraces the healing power of whitetail hunting.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The Odyssea Sportfishing family grows as Casey Villone comes aboard as Rush's new deck hand. While Rush gained a helping hand on his charters, he also scored a new "Fishing Mate" who is always game to bend a rod. With a day off and a report of Tuna offshore, the two head out to see if they can beat the sharks and land a Key West sushi dinner.

programme.title: Super Retriever
programme.desc: The Amateur Division reaches its climax at the Super Retriever Series Crown Championship. Top teams battle through the final rounds of Retriever Trials, where every point matters. In the end, one standout handler and dog team rises above the rest to be crowned Amateur SRS Crown Champions. At the same time, the excitement continues on the dock as fun-loving canine athletes compete for their own Crown victories in SRS Super Dock.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Axis deer have always been an opportunity for Will Cooper—but never the main pursuit. In Chasing Spots, Will heads to Central Texas to hunt free-range Axis deer for the first time alongside good friend Casey Sanford. Hunting the opening of the Axis rut, the two battle summer heat, and cover miles of Texas Hill-Country.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Kansas doesn’t give up giants easily. After a tough early-season grind chasing Midwest whitetails, HuntStand’s Will Cooper left Kansas with unfinished business. But the season wasn’t over. In December, he returned to face brutal winds, bitter cold, long sits, and a mature Kansas buck that always seemed to stay one step ahead. What started as another trip to the Midwest quickly became a test of patience, persistence, and just how long you’re willing to stay in the game. Because some hunts come together fast. Others make you earn every second of them.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Massive wildfires had consumed thousands of acres across the Bighorn Mountains and the neighboring foothills. Would the annual HuntStand pronghorn camp be a total bust, or would the crew be able to find a few animals beyond the smoke?

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.desc: The Vaal Reedbuck is one of the most elusive plains game animals in Africa. Known for their incredible eyesight and nervous nature, they rarely stick around once spotted. On this hunt in South Africa’s Eastern Cape, Mark Peterson sets out into rugged hill country and open grasslands in pursuit of one of these wary antelope.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson’s South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species. Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: In this episode of Road Trip Angler, Jameson Redding is exploring St. Marks, Florida, along with his friend Chris Funk trying to catch a species of Bass that is unique to the area.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade ends the saga with a deer he has watched for a few years, Pope. programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade gives you the grand tour of his home property. Slade’s dream was the same as many others, have a place where he can build a home, raise a family, and also have plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors and chase big rack bucks. Slade gives you a breakdown of how he took his raw tract of land and turned it into a beautiful homestead and outdoor paradise. If you are interested in how you can achieve your dream of raising a family on a dream property, this is the episode for you.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips

Austin capitalizes on a first sit opportunity on a true Mississippi giant over a Backwoods Attraction food plot! Three first sit bucks taken for the Road Trips crew at the Backwoods testing grounds!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
